description: This file defines the ListViewFacade class which acts as a facade for managing list views in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for initializing, configuring, and displaying list views, as well as retrieving display columns based on module metadata.

classes.name: ListViewFacade
classes.description: A facade class that simplifies interaction with ListView and ListViewSmarty components for listing records in SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ListViewFacade with focus, module, and type, then builds the appropriate list view object.

methods.name: getDisplayColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the display columns definition for a given module, looking into custom and standard metadata files.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Determines whether to use ListView or ListViewSmarty based on existing templates and initializes the view component.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the list view with template, filters, display parameters, and query settings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the list view HTML, either directly or as a return value.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the list view display.
